newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Mansfield, N.J..

text.p: SEALED PROPOSALS will be received by the Chief Financial Officer of the Township of Mansfield in the County of Burlington, New Jersey (the '
Complex, 24548 East Main Street, Columbus, New Jersey 08022- 0250, on

until 11:00 a.m. at which time they will be publicly opened and announced, for the purchase of the Township's $2,740,000 aggregate principal amount of General Improvement Bonds, Series 1997 (the Bonds'') dated May 15, 1997 and maturing, subject to prior redemption, on May 15 as follows:
Year Amount Year Amount Year Amount
Individual purchases of beneficial ownership interests in the Bonds will be made in book-entry form (without

certificates) in the denomination of $5,000 each or any integral multiple thereof, except that such minimum amount of the last maturing Bonds in excess of the largest principal amount thereof equaling a multiple of $5,000 will be in the denominations of $1,000, or any integral multiple thereof, as may be necessary to comply with the proposal for Bonds of the successful bidder to accept less than the full amount of the Bonds offered for sale, in accordance with the Notice of Sale dated May 6, 1997 (the Notice of Sale''). The Bonds will bear interest at the rate or rates of interest in a multiple of 1/8 or 1/20 of 1% per annum specified by the successful bidder payable on November 15, 1997 and semi-annually thereafter on May 15 and November 15 in each year until maturity. The Bonds will be sold to the bidder specifying the lowest net interest cost in accordance with the terms of the Notice of Sale. Copies of the Preliminary Official Statement, the Notice of Sale, the Proposal for Bonds and the form of the legal opinion of DeCotiis, Fitzpatrick & Gluck, Trenton, New Jersey, bond counsel to the Township, may be obtained from the Chief Financial Officer of the Township at the Municipal
Complex, 24548 East Main Street, Columbus, New Jersey 0 0250 telephone (609) 298-4455.
Joan B. Slane, Chief Financial Officer
